title: Payout Methods Corridor Rates for High-Volume Currency Conversion
content:
The percentage applied to the conversion fee on a Payout Methods transfer is set by the method's conversion volume, the total of the transfers sent to the method less than 12 whole months before the settlement day, the transfer the fee belongs to included.

## Corridor rate schedule

| Method's payout currency | Conversion volume over the window | Percentage applied to the conversion fee |
|---|---|---|
| CAD or MXN | At least USD 8000.00 | 1.25% |
| EUR or GBP | At least USD 8000.00 | 1.50% |
| Any other method | — | No corridor rate: the rail's own cross-currency fee percentage |

A method paid in CAD or MXN whose conversion volume is below USD 8000.00, and a method paid in EUR or GBP whose conversion volume is below USD 8000.00, fall in the last line.

## Terms of the schedule

- **Settlement day.** The day the conversion fee falls due: the rail's processing time in business days on the business-day calendar after the day the transfer was sent. The window is counted to that day.
- **Conversion volume.** The sum of the USD amounts of the transfers sent to this method on payout dates less than 12 whole months before the settlement day, including the transfer the fee belongs to. A transfer sent exactly 12 whole months before the settlement day is outside the window.
- **Threshold.** USD 8000.00 is met by a volume of USD 8000.00 or more; USD 7999.99 does not meet it.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Payout currency | Settlement day | Transfers in the volume | Conversion volume | Percentage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| MXN | 2026-05-12 | Transfers sent from 2025-05-13 onward, this transfer included | USD 8000.00 | 1.25% |
| MXN | 2026-05-12 | Same, one transfer of USD 0.01 less | USD 7999.99 | Rail's own percentage |
| GBP | 2026-05-12 | A USD 600.00 transfer sent 2025-05-12 (exactly 12 whole months before) and later transfers totalling USD 7500.00 | USD 7500.00: the 2025-05-12 transfer is outside the window | Rail's own percentage |
| EUR | 2026-05-12 | Later transfers totalling USD 7500.00 and a USD 600.00 transfer sent 2025-05-13 (11 whole months before) | USD 8100.00 | 1.50% |

## Basis questions

- *Does the transfer being charged count toward its own volume?* Yes; the volume includes the transfer the fee belongs to.
- *Is the volume counted per host or per method?* Per method: the transfers sent to that method.
- *A method paid in CAD with USD 9000.00 of volume: which corridor applies?* The CAD or MXN corridor, 1.25%.
